title: AI as Forge

hero.headline: Use AI to transform material, not to manufacture authority.
hero.support: A recovered landing projection for disciplined human-AI collaboration: search, compare, generate, critique, restructure, and test faster while keeping provenance, claim ceilings, review gates, and consequential judgment outside the model.

sections.heading: Forge, not oracle
sections.body: AI can accelerate transformation and expose candidate structure. It does not make unsupported output true by producing it fluently.

sections.heading: Keep the source attached
sections.body: Useful AI work remains coupled to evidence, artifacts, decisions, citations, provenance, and reconstructible transformations.

sections.heading: Separate generation from promotion
sections.body: Candidate claims, interpretations, code, and designs are generated cheaply; promotion into durable or public artifacts requires explicit review.

sections.heading: Critique is part of generation
sections.body: Operator, critic, and human-gate roles reduce the risk that a single conversational trajectory silently becomes canon.

sections.heading: Authority remains consequential
sections.body: The party able to understand, accept, deploy, publish, or repair the result retains responsibility for those actions.
